messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue growth detected in region us-west3 (pool=rw-gpu-usw3). Pending requests: 820, autoscaler attempts failing for >6 minutes. Trigger: queue > 500 for 5m.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Starting triage — what's the autoscaler failing on?

james (sre): Looks like GCP returns quotaExceeded on instance create: "requested GPUs (8) exceeds project quota for region us-west3". Autoscaler log snippet: `error: quotaExceeded, reason: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, details: GPU quota`.

alex (eng-runtime): Confirmed from runtime side. Autoscaler tried to add 8 T4s (preemptible group), got 403/quota. KV cache still fine, but request queue is backing up. p95 latency climbed from 2.3s -> 12s for queued batches.

sara (oncall): Can we failover to another region quickly? Any capacity elsewhere?

alex (eng-runtime): us-central1 and eu-west1 have spare capacity. The routing policy currently pins some customers to us-west3; I can enable emergency region-fallback for non-SLA traffic in ~2 mins. Need a thumbs from SRE to also throttle low-priority queues.

maria (customer-success): Noted customer impact: several small customers and one enterprise tenant (acme-inc) showing elevated latencies/errors originating from us-west3. Drafting an external status message now.

theo (oncall-2nd): If we reroute, acme-inc might see extra latency. Can we also offer CPU fallback for low-priority inference? Might degrade quality but keeps requests flowing.

james (sre): Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Throttle low-priority batch queues (reduce concurrency/batch size). 2) Patch autoscaler to prefer cpu-only instance-template for low-priority traffic. 3) Open a quota increase request with GCP (I've opened ticket 1234567890). 4) If needed, route non-SLA to us-central1.

sara (oncall): Do the throttles and routing. Alex, flip fallback policy. James, paste the GCP ticket link here and add justification (production incident, customer impact).

alex (eng-runtime): Pushing route change: enabling `region_fallback: emergency-us-central1` gate and setting canary 10%. Patch in progress.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for route change (canary=10%, id=deploy-2026-04-rf).

alex (eng-runtime): Canary is live. CPU-fallback nodes in us-central1 are accepting lower-priority traffic. Queue dropped from 820 -> 310 over 7 minutes. p95 latency improved to ~4.8s overall.

maria (customer-success): Sending status to acme-inc: "We are seeing degraded performance in us-west3; some traffic is being served from fallback region us-central1. We will provide updates as we progress." Would like an ETA to pass to them.

james (sre): GCP response (via support-bot): quota increase requires manual review; estimated ETA 6-12 hours unless we provide rapid justification and commit to committed use. They suggested trying a different GPU SKU (if available) or using multi-region fallback.

sara (oncall): Plan A: maintain fallback routing + throttles until queue drained. Plan B: if queue > 500 again or CPU fallback saturates, escalate to paging-all and start cross-region scale-up playbook. Handoff to Theo in 30m unless it improves.

theo (oncall-2nd): I'll take over at +30m. Will monitor autoscaler events and GCP ticket. If quota is the only blocker, we should prepare long-term: request regional quota increase and pre-warm other regions.

incident-bot: Incident created RW-INC-2026-0417 | severity=sev2 | owner=sara (oncall) | linked_ticket=1234567890.

maria (customer-success): I'll post a customer status update to #customer-bulletins after the next health check. Uploading draft now.

james (sre): Commands we used to throttle low-priority pool and prefer cpu templates:

```
# throttle low-priority deployment
kubectl -n inference patch deploy pool-low-priority -p '\"spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [{ name: inference, resources: { limits: { cpu: \"500m\", memory: \"1Gi\" } } }] } } }\"'

# patch autoscaler to prefer CPU-only template for low-priority
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template rw-autoscaler-low-prio --instance-template=cpu-only-template --region=us-west3
```

sara (oncall): Thanks. Keep monitoring dashboards and error rates. Next check-in in 15m. If anything spikes, ping `@here` and escalate. :thumbsup:
